\begin{theorem}[Exact local ghost witness on the cylinder]
On the unit Lorentzian conformal cylinder, set
\[T=\Box\delta-\frac13d\delta^2+\frac R3\delta
-\operatorname{Ric}\circ\delta+\frac13d\langle\operatorname{Ric},h\rangle.\]
Then $TK=\Box(\Box+2)$ on one-forms.  With the
action-normalized $B_{\rm lin}$ and
$H=B_{\rm lin}+\frac12KT$, one has
\[B_{\rm lin}K=0,\qquad HK=\frac12K\Box(\Box+2).\]
The ghost block is a composition of two normally hyperbolic
operators.  The graded self-adjoint backward blocks
$(T,2\sharp^{-1},T^\sharp)$ give field block $2H$.
No direct same-bundle factorization of $H$ is asserted.
\end{theorem}
